decisions.reason: This recruitment service is far from the firm's maritime core, shows no visible traction beyond being listed for two years, and with several stronger core-related options available the option value now looks weaker than the opportunity cost of keeping it.

Superyacht crew recruitment extends existing crewing capabilities into an adjacent niche, and because it remains on the website after launch while likely costing little to maintain, it is still worth keeping as an option.

The maritime education programme directly fits the firm's training and crewing base, and its rapid build-up to six partner institutions suggests enough early momentum to continue learning and scaling.

Emissions monitoring and compliance services are close to the core offer, strongly aligned with the firm's environmental direction, and early execution success across all relevant vessels supports continued commitment.

The emissions compliance dashboard is strategically aligned, embedded in the firm's existing PAL software, and likely inexpensive to keep while regulation-driven demand and client adoption develop further.

The emissions compliance cost simulation tool uses the same digital and regulatory capabilities as the dashboard, and as an integrated decision-support add-on it retains meaningful upside with limited incremental downside.
